title: Religión y conocimiento
goal: Read how religion and knowledge were the same profession across the Inca, Maya and Mexica worlds, and explain how a lost medical manuscript resurfaced centuries later.

items: Explain the Andean concept of pacha and what a huaca was.
Explain why losing a city's scribes was so damaging for the Maya.
Describe the role Mexica priest-astronomers played in imperial decisions.
Explain what the Codex De la Cruz-Badiano is and how it survived.
Use 'a lo largo de' and 'a raíz de' to describe historical spans and causes.
